description: 1. PROFILE SETUP: Agent must rewrite ~/act/profile.md to include all Decision Checklist fields: test date (Feb 2025), target composite (30), baseline composite (~22-24), all 4 colleges, user type (student), study hours (8/week), and Writing section = NOT REQUIRED. 2. ERROR ANALYSIS: Agent must read all 3 practice test files and update each of the 4 section files (english/math/reading/science.md) with WHY-based error analysis — e.g., 'missed comma splice rules,' 'trig formula gaps,' 'pacing failure on passage 3' — not merely scores. This is the proprietary trap: generic agents log counts/scores, but SKILL.md mandates logging reasons. 3. SUPERSCORE COMPUTATION (the key proprietary trap): Agent must understand that ACT superscore = taking the BEST individual section score across multiple test attempts: English=max(24,26,25)=26, Math=max(21,22,24)=24, Reading=max(23,21,22)=23, Science=max(22,25,23)=25, yielding a superscore composite of (26+24+23+25)/4=24.5≈25 — NOT the best single-test composite of 24. This distinction is critical and non-obvious without SKILL.md. 4. FEEDBACK: Agent must update feedback.md with real strategic observations (not placeholder text). 5. COLLEGE TARGETING: Agent must note Jordan's current ~24-25 superscore vs. Ohio State's 27-33 range (gap) vs. IU's 24-31 range (borderline competitive). 6. WRITING SECTION: sections/writing.md must be updated to clearly reflect that Writing is not required for any of Jordan's target colleges, and no Writing prep resources should be allocated.
